                        Assistant Commissioner

       DATE:            May 16, 1988

       SUBJECT:         INSTALLATION OF WATER METERS



       Section P107.1 of RS-16 requires the installation of water meters to
       be subject to inspection and approval by the Department of
       Environmental Protection (DEP) which would be in accordance with their
       Rules and Regulations.        On December 19, 1987, Department of
       Environmental Protection's regulations were amended so as to not
       require licensed plumbers for the installation of water meters. As a
       result of this change in DEP's regulations the following procedures
       shall be the policy of this Department:

                  The installation of water meters on water service piping of
                  less than 1 1/2" diameter is hereafter deemed to constitute a
                  minor alteration, pursuant to Section 27-124 (C26-104.1) of
                  the Code. Therefore, installation of water meters on water
                  service piping of less than 1/2" diameter may be performed
                  without obtaining a permit as per Section 27-147
                  (C26-109.1), moreover, as provided in Section 27-896
                  (C26-1600.1), as long as the work is performed under the
                   jurisdiction of the Department of Environmental Protection,
                  such minor alterations need not be performed by a master
                  plumber.

       This memorandum shall be effective immediately.
